[h3]Sinners! Praise the Miracle, for the [b]Blasphemous: The Board Game[/b] campaign goes live on [url=https://gamefound.com/en/projects/lms/blasphemous-the-boardgame?refcode=MpClbF1cqUeuLn1sh55DkQ]GAMEFOUND[/url] on 25th February![/h3]

[b]Blasphemous: The Board Game[/b] is a competitive game for 1-4 people, where players take on the role of penitents, heroes marked by guilt and redemption, engaged in a pilgrimage to explore the lands of Cvstodia. Set foot in familiar and dangerous locations, solving quests until you find and battle the final boss of your adventure.

Grow your Penitent through Prayers, Rosary Beads, and customizable dice that you can configure throughout your journey depending on the dangers you face. Immerse yourself in the fantastic and terrifying universe created by The Game Kitchen, with a story full of mysteries, dangers and choices.

Travel through iconic locations from the video game, face enemies, and complete quests to prepare for the Boss encounter.

Each Boss has its own unique victory condition, which is not always a direct battle, but can be achieved by tackling different enemies and using different strategies.

[b]MAKE YOUR PENITENT UNIQUE[/b]
Custom dice evolve with gameplay experience, making your Penitent unique in every game. Prayers and beads further define their abilities.

[b]STORY BOOKS[/b]
Uncover the secrets of Cvstodia through story booklets: each quest contains up to four booklets, one general and up to three specific.

[b]EXCLUSIVE[/b]
The [i]gamefound[/i] Edition is a limited, exclusive release tied only to the campaign, featuring customizable dice and an expanded map.

notes.title: Blasphemous 2 Revealed
notes.content:
[h3]PENANCE NEVER ENDS AS BLASPHEMOUS 2 IS REVEALED[/h3]

[b]The Penitent One returns for the highly anticipated sequel to The Game Kitchen’s 2019 multi-award-winning action platformer.[/b]

Team17 Digital and The Game Kitchen have premiered the very first look of Blasphemous 2! Coming to Steam later this year, Blasphemous 2 follows The Penitent One as he awakens in an unfamiliar land, displaced from his final resting place, and thrust back into the endless cycle of life, death, and resurrection.

[b]Penance begins anew in this first look at Blasphemous 2:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ReA837m2VgY;full][/previewyoutube]


Set after the events of the original Blasphemous’ 2021 update Wounds of Eventide, Blasphemous 2 sees the return of the supernatural entity The Miracle, leaving The Penitent One no choice but to explore a strange unfamiliar world, defeat the monstrosities that lay in wait, and try to stop the prophetic birth of a new miracle child from coming to pass. Featuring grotesque enemies and titanic bosses clambering to return him to the grave, The Penitent One will need to utilise and master new weapons and an enhanced skillset and try to survive long enough to deliver judgment to those who stand in his way, while unravelling long forgotten secrets.

[*] [b]Play your way[/b]: Blasphemous 2 provides the ability to customise and improve the Penitent Ones’ base skillset, and introduces new unique weapons that expand player tactics
[*] [b]Overcome intense Boss Battles:[/b] Twisted bosses with unique attack patterns and sundering abilities await in the darkest corners of this twisted new land

notes.content:
Sinners,

Today we are incredibly excited to share with you not one, but two announcements for Blasphemous.

All will be revealed in the trailer below...

[h1]Penance Never Ends...[/h1]

[previewyoutube=UJ9yIOuvGmU;full][/previewyoutube]

The team would also like to say another, very special thank you to you, our amazing community.

notes.title: Blasphemous: Strife & Ruin - Live Now!
notes.content:
Dear Penitents,

We are excited to announce that Blasphemous: Strife & Ruin is live now on Steam!

This free update is available to all players and includes new ordeals for you to face as the Penitent One, Korean language support, some bug fixes and a retro treat for the inquisitive...

[previewyoutube=a5kyMVGRHjI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[b]Miriam’s Challenges[/b]

"Something in this suffering land, brought me to this place…”

The Penitent One has gained a new ally as Miriam from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/692850/Bloodstained_Ritual_of_the_Night/]Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night[/url] crosses over into the land of Cvstodia!
[list]
[*]A totally new quest in which Miriam, star of Bloodstained - Ritual of the Night, makes an appearance.
[*]To be able to return to her world, you must retrieve the crystal shards located at the end of the 5 hidden challenges.
[/list]
Miriam's questline can be started in New Game, New Game+ and in existing saves.

If you'd like to know the area where you can find Miriam and begin her quest we have a hint for you here: [spoiler]Miriam can be found waiting for you in the Mother of Mothers.[/spoiler]


[b]Sacred Sorrows Mode[/b]

Boss Rush comes to Blasphemous! Pit the Penitent One against the toughest of foes in an unrelenting onslaught of penance and suffering.
[list]
[*]Fight against all the Blasphemous bosses in this new “Boss Rush” mode.
[*]5 different unlockable courses, each with 2 difficulty levels.
[*]Try to beat your best time and achieve the highest rank.
[/list]
Please note: In order to unlock and play Sacred Sorrows Mode you must have completed Blasphemous at least once.

[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*]A new background has been added to the main menu.
[*]Various elements of the existing levels have been tweaked.
[*]New animated scenes have been added to the game.
[/list]

[b]Voices[/b]
[list]
[*]New lines have been recorded for Miriam in English and Spanish.
[*]New lines have been recorded for Diosdado.
[/list]

[b]New items[/b]
[list]
[*]A new Prayer has been added.
[*]A new Rosary Bead has been added.
[/list]

[b]Languages[/b]
[list]
[*]Korean language support has been added.
[*]Various corrections have been made in several languages.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]A new hidden retro area has been included for players to discover.
[*]A new rendering mode menu has been added.
[*]A new menu has been added for checking your Blasphemous achievements.
[*]An alert has been added to the game that informs you when an achievement has been unlocked.
[*]Diosdado’s quest conditions have been tweaked.
[/list]

[b]Technique Update: Air Impulse[/b]

Air Impulse is an advanced technique that allows the Penitent One to ascend and gain height after hitting an enemy up to two consecutive times. 

Prior to this update the only way this move could be activated was by holding down in mid-air as you struck an enemy. Whilst this worked fine for combat situations, Miriam's challenges introduces new platforming set pieces which require use of this move outside of combat situations. Because of this we've added a second way to activate this technique: Right Trigger + Attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/5d5944dbec77614997e5b004aa961e69742eea07.png[/img]

This should make it easier to make use of this technique both in and outside of combat, particularly in the content mentioned above. Don't worry if you prefer the original input method though, you can still use that if you'd rather.


[b]We hope you enjoy Blasphemous: Strife & Ruin![/b]

That concludes today's update notes for Strife & Ruin. 

We're incredibly happy to bring this awesome crossover with Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night to you, as well as the rest of the new content! Calling all Penitents and Sinners alike,

Blasphemous is nominated in the 'Labor of Love' category for the 2020 Steam Awards! As the Miracle wills it, we must reach out and seek to claim this prestigious relic for the land of Cvstodia!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/2e8374b96c7da084489d8f1a1f8a0b9566effb67.png[/img]

[h1]The Path to Penance[/h1]

Blasphemous began its pilgrimage on Steam on September 10th, 2019. Many of you raised Mea Culpa for the first time on this date, twisting fate to your will as you challenged and triumphed over the twisted, the corrupted and the zealous.

[b]Blasphemous Launch Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=Ctm-GClM6wo;full][/previewyoutube]

Since that day, many more of you have swelled the ranks of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, further building a community around Blasphemous that we are humbled to serve.

As the community continued to grow, we set about working on your feedback around bug fixes, quality of life improvements and more - all of this driven by what we saw being discussed by you, our players.


[b]The Stir of Dawn[/b]
[previewyoutube=9QdGzJhunb4;full][/previewyoutube]

Then, in August of this year we released our first free DLC for Blasphemous, The Stir of Dawn, adding a host of new features including:
[list]
[*]New Game + (True Torment Mode)
[*]New story quests
[*]New bosses, prayers and items
[*]New ways to play via the Penitence system
[*]New executions
[*]Visual update and location overhauls
[*]Map overhaul
[*]More fast travel options
[/list]
and more...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/50f45ea47c5cbf8bca0584d9f38fac482c01b16e.gif[/img]

Some of you may already know this, but The Game Kitchen is a Spanish Developer Team! 

As such, when creating Blasphemous we took inspiration from our home country, it's architecture and its history. But, we were missing one key part of our home... Its language.

This was rectified when we released The Stir of Dawn as it came with a full, optional Spanish voice over for all characters in the game.

We were privileged to work with a fantastic and prestigious group of actors, check them out below:
[previewyoutube=vKfree2PJ_A;full][/previewyoutube]

Just like The Stir of Dawn DLC it was apart of, this content came absolutely free to all our players.  


[b]Mac & Linux Support[/b]

Whilst we worked away on the above content, part of the team were busy creating Mac and Linux versions of Blasphemous for their respective communities here on Steam!

We're pleased to say that in September of this year those versions became feature complete and arrived on Steam with full parity with the Windows version of the game, including with it The Stir of Dawn DLC and all quality of life patches / fixes the game had seen.


[h1]Penance never truly ends[/h1]

With that, our dear Penitents, we are all but finished with our post where we humbly ask that you vote for Blasphemous to receive Steam's 'Labor of Love' award.

Each and every one of your votes will go a long way, and who knows, if the Miracle wills it we may even be blessed with such an accolade!

[b]But know this, Cvstodia still has much left to reveal as Blasphemous' next free DLC arrives in 2021![/b]

Penitent be the heart.

notes.title: The Stir of Dawn - Bug Fix & Optimisation Patch 1 Live Now!
notes.content:
Sinners,

Thank you all for sharing your thoughts, feedback and bug reports on The Stir of Dawn free DLC.

The team have loved hearing about your experiences and really appreciate everyone that took a moment to make us aware of certain issues that needed addressing.

Before we dive into the patch notes, a certain person who created the bosses you fight in The Stir of Dawn has a message for you...


[h1][b]A Message From Maikel - The Stir of Dawn[/b][/h1]

Hello Sinners! It's Maikel, from The Game Kitchen.

The response for the release of our free DLC, The Stir of Dawn, has been INCREDIBLE. You've sent us so many kind words over social media, emails, and comments, that it took days and days to read all of that.

We're really glad you liked the new content that much: the Penitences System, the spanish VO, and of course the dog-petting opportunities. Thanks a lot for your support, we at the development team are really grateful.

Releasing a huge update is not an easy feat though, and unfortunately it also comes with a new batch of issues and bugs. But we've been hammering down non-stop, and there's a lot of fixes coming your way!

Those pesky Penitence Rewards will finally be actually granted to worthy penitents, and there's a lot more fixes included.

Again, thanks for your support, and I hope you'll keep enjoying Blasphemous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/50f45ea47c5cbf8bca0584d9f38fac482c01b16e.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Patch 1 Notes - Fixes & Optimisations[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/7942d7522383176660f0707dd2af7869704ca43a.gif[/img]

[h1]Optimisations[/h1]

After receiving reports about performance issues on machines with low specs, we have further optimised the gameplay and UI code.

We have also located and fixed a few memory leaks that were causing slowdown after long sessions of gameplay on rare occasions. 


[h1]Key Fixes[/h1]

[b]Penitence Rewards - Rosary Beads[/b]

Fixed an issue that caused Penitences rewards to reset after the credits, so players weren’t able to access their rewards. 

This is a retroactive fix, so you will be able to find the corresponding rewards you already earned in your current save slots.


[b]Laudes - Post Fight Area[/b]

Fixed several issues with the location entered after the fight with Laudes, which could cause softlock, weird collisions, and even stop players from getting the reward located there.


[b]Tres Angustias - "Dodge this"[/b]

Fixed an issue that caused Tres Angustias beam attack anticipation to appear outside the screen, so dodging them was only possible with the help of the Miracle.


[b]Amanecidas Combat - Fight on![/b]

Fixed issues during Amanecidas combats that created weird interactions after interrupting their attacks. This caused them to stop attacking anymore during the fight on rare occasions.


[b]Ten Piedad - "You're approaching me?!"[/b]

Fixed Ten Piedad fight so it can no longer be skipped by using the Linen of Golden Thread.


[h1]Other Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the room in Gemino’s quest could be used to farm tears of atonement. 
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the main menu background selection labels to display incorrect titles.
[*]Fixed an issue where Bleeding Miracle explosion didn’t cause damage to enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck inside a wall during a True Torment playthrough. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Penitence Selection menu to behave incorrectly during a second playthrough. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Chalice of Inverted Verses was not emptied after using a Prie Dieu warp point. 
[*]Fixed a LOT of issues causing diverse achievements to not unlock correctly. 
[*]Fixed map issues that caused some tiles to not reveal on rare occasions.
[*]Fixed an issue that created duplicates of the Penitent One while button-mashing during the cutest animation in the game. Please, keep petting that dog though, he’s a really good boy. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Ash Mountain wouldn’t slow down the Penitent One. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Esdras to remain still and refuse to fight back. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused abandoned Penitences to remain marked as so, even after completing them in a later playthrough. 
[/list]

[h1]Penance Never Truly Ends...[/h1]

That wraps today's patch notes!

We hope these fixes bring blessings to your time in Cvstodia, thank you again for your patience and understanding whilst the team addressed what you fed back to us.

Penitent be the heart!

notes.title: The Stir of Dawn Free DLC - Live Now!
notes.content:
And so the long night is severed. Dawn cometh.

[previewyoutube=M_kGG-SD8oA;full][/previewyoutube]

Dawn has arrived in the land of Cvstodia in Blasphemous: The Stir of Dawn, a free DLC available now for all owners of Blasphemous!


[h1][b]The Stir of Dawn - Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

To prepare you for your journey into True Torment we've compiled today's Patch Notes below for you. 

We've also included some extra context from Maikel Ortega, Game Designer on Blasphemous - you can spot his comments in [i]italics[/i]!


[h1]True Torment: New Game+[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ascend into True Torment after beating the game at least once.
[*]You will keep your items, Prayers and Mea Culpa abilities. Master them to advance through this harder version of the game.
[/list]
[i]After finishing the main game, you will now be able to Ascend into our New Game+ mode: True Torment. This means starting a new playthrough from the beginning, keeping all your unlocked skills, and equippable items such as Rosary Beads, Sword Hearts and Prayers. And you will need them! 

The difficulty has been carefully rebalanced to offer a greater challenge. Enemies will be tougher and much more deadly, so making full use of your arsenal is a must if you want to survive the True Torment.[/i] 


[h1]The Penitence System[/h1]
[list]
[*]Choose between one of three Penitences, and face even greater challenges that change the way you approach each playthrough.
[*]Only available during a True Torment playthrough.
[*]Successful Penitence completions have their rewards...
[/list]

[i][b]The Penitence of the Bleeding Heart[/b] is our homage to classic 8-bit titles like Castlevania where we have replaced the Penitent One’s lifebar with Health Orbs. Every hit you take will deplete one orb, and to keep things interesting, all enemies will respawn every time you come back to an area. So you will really need to learn their patterns if you want to stay alive![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/1fbf19dd6084c5ccbd18a4be9570258a4cdd8488.jpg[/img]


[i][b]The Penitence of the Unwavering Faith[/b] severely weakens your normal attacks with Mea Culpa, but adds constant Fervour regeneration! Prayers and abilities will be your main source of damage, so plan your build accordingly, and choose appropriate Rosary Beads and Sword Hearts![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/05c3d04a3041a470c2d153e2e573d018e54e230f.jpg[/img]


[i]And the final is the [b]Penitence of the True Guilt[/b] — by far the most punishing of the three. Choosing this Penitence will change your Bile Flasks into Azure Flasks where they will no longer replenish your health, but your fervour instead. And keeping yourself out of harm’s way is a must in this run, as you will lose all your Guilt Fragments and Tears of Atonement with a single death! Find a Confessor Statue, or retrieve your Fragment, or you will lose all those hard-earned tears too! Only true masters of Blasphemous’ combat will be able to rise to this challenge.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/71839bc78953221dae24b9bb48850a4ccde3951c.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Stir of Dawn Questline[/h1]

[list]
[*]A completely new quest can be started buried deep in the innards of the Holy Line.
[*]Only available during a True Torment playthrough.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/f104e5feed46f82f42055f7ff8ebd85ed10f0283.gif[/img]

[i]The Amanecidas - Ancient creatures, born and forgotten centuries ago, will wake up from the innards of Cvstodia and try to stop The Penitent One. Find Jibrael, their harbinger, during a True Torment run, and follow his instructions to challenge these gilded wardens of the Miracle. This new storyline includes five completely new boss fights, harder than any other you’ve faced before in Blasphemous.[/i] 

  
[h1]Map Screen Overhaul[/h1]

[list]
[*]The map has been completely redesigned and reworked.
[*]Custom markers can now be placed anywhere on the map.
[*]The map now features pixel perfect zoom.
[*]The percentage of area discovery is now visible in a corner.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/18d3185a37464d3a27be5c7e7e3556dc4db19bbb.jpg[/img]


[h1]Changes to the Core Game[/h1]

[b]NPC Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]A new NPC can be found close to Albero, in the Desecrated Cistern.
[*]The NPC Soledad has been reworked, and features fully voiced new dialog.
[*]The NPC Gémino has been reworked, and now features new sprites. His questline has been slightly tweaked.
[*]New dialog lines have been added to several NPCs and Bosses.
[/list]

[b]Fast Travel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/54d649c27cbd46582cc4785f44cabfcf8a341b41.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]The Prie Dieu is now upgradeable, allowing for fast travel between the altars.
[*]Three new Teleports can now be found in Cvstodia.
[*]New areas and shortcuts have been added to the game.
[/list]

[b]Voiceover[/b]

[previewyoutube=vKfree2PJ_A;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]As requested by many of our players from all around the world, we have added full Spanish VO, recorded by top notch voice actors and actresses. Our game is heavily inspired by our culture, so this was a no-brainer![/i]
[list]
[*]Full Spanish voice-over has been added to the game. The voice-over language can be changed in the options menu.
[*]Some of the existing dialog has been recorded again with a new cast.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]A mysterious alms-box can be found inside the church in Albero.
[/list]

[b]New Executions[/b]
[list]
[*]Sister of the Charred Visage
[*]Spear of the Cathedra
[*]Guardainfante
[*]Lunatic
[*]Phalaris
[*]Wandering Sepulcher
[*]Carthos
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/a86693973ceacbaeeff28783873780f1088f6615.gif[/img]
Certain Penitent skills (Charge, Lunge & Counter attacks) will now stun these enemies when used at the right time, enabling an execution.


[h1]Art & Cutscenes[/h1]

[b]Art[/b]

The following areas now feature new art assets:
[list]
[*]Wasteland of the Buried Churches
[*]Mercy Dreams
[*]Grievance Ascends
[*]Patio of the Silent Steps
[*]Bridge of the Three Calvaries

[*]Wall of the Holy Prohibitions
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/4d5fb9c64d8668ecf6bb11cf073b30037df577b9.gif[/img]

New dwellers can be found in town, including a completely pettable and very good boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/50f45ea47c5cbf8bca0584d9f38fac482c01b16e.gif[/img]

Some sprites, including the player's, now feature colour adjustments to better integrate in certain areas.

New animations have also been added to the Penitent One.

[b]Cutscenes[/b]
[list]
[*]New animated cutscenes have been added to the game.
[*]A new intro cutscene has been added.

[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes: Prayers & Enemies[/h1]

[i]As a game designer, fine tuning the experience you players will face in our game is always our main priority. This is why we took our time to create a satisfying True Torment mode, but also revisited the base game! Lots of Prayers, Rosary Beads, and even player skills have been revisited, tweaked, and, in some cases, made some pretty big changes. 

Summon an army of Cherubs with the improved Campanilleros Prayer, or stun your foes with a perfectly timed Sacred Onslaught to the face, leaving them open for a gruesome execution.[/i]

[h1]The Amanecidas Await...[/h1]

notes.title: The Stir of Dawn: Map Screen Overhaul, More Fast Travelling and Rebalancing!
notes.content:
Hello Sinners,

Following on from our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/774361/announcements/detail/2719563557124885797]Torment, Penitence and Amanecidas post[/url] earlier this week we wanted to take the opportunity to share even more with you on what’s coming in The Stir of Dawn!

When creating The Stir of Dawn the team were keen to read through player and community feedback to see what you really enjoyed about your Blasphemous playthrough, as well as what you thought could be further built upon or adjusted to improve your experience with the game.

The team spent a lot of time discussing what we learnt from the community and where possible we have implemented it into The Stir of Dawn!

To begin, let’s start with one of the most commonly requested feature updates - The Map!


[h1]Map Overhaul & New Features[/h1]

Rejoice, the map screen you currently know has been fully overhauled!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/18d3185a37464d3a27be5c7e7e3556dc4db19bbb.jpg[/img]

When looking at how to improve the map for The Stir of Dawn we approached it from the angle of improving overall usage, readability, practicality and usefulness to the player.

We are pleased to confirm the following features in the map overhaul:
[list]
[*][b]Complete rework of the old screen[/b] - Out with the old, in with the new!
[*][b]Tile Resolutions[/b] - Choose between different handmade tile resolutions to get your ideal setting.
[*][b]Map Markers[/b] - Manually mark points of interest and other useful locations to aid you in your journey through Cvstodia.
[*][b]Map Completion[/b] - Wonder no more! The percentage of rooms completed will be visible on the map.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/6369fa1ba71fed8069361fa46380ec67fda2865b.jpg[/img]

Now we’ve revealed the new map and how it works, let's take a look at another hotly requested improvement - expanded fast travel!


[h1]New Warp Points & Shortcuts![/h1]

[b]Warp Points[/b]

Upon installing The Stir of Dawn update new fast travel options will be available to all players whether they’re playing on ‘New Game’ or ‘New Game+’ modes.

On top of the existing fast travel system, players will now be able to upgrade the Prie Dieu altars throughout Cvstodia. 

Upon doing so they will gain a new look, activating the ability to travel between any previously visited Prie Dieu altars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/54d649c27cbd46582cc4785f44cabfcf8a341b41.gif[/img]

This new feature offers a lot of versatility and travel options, minimising excess backtracking and allowing you even more freedom to explore the map.


[b]Shortcuts[/b]

Whispers travel through the townsfolk of Abero, rumours of new shortcuts that are on the cusp of being discovered by the keen eyes of the Penitent One…

These new shortcuts which we’ll be leaving for you to discover allow for some natural transitions between certain areas to aid you in your travels, if you can find them that is!


[h1]Prayer Buffs, Enemy Behaviour and Passive Effects![/h1]

[b]Prayers[/b]

Most of the Prayers in the game have received blessing from the Miracle, increasing their damage or effects for the Penitent One. To reflect these changes their costs have also been tweaked. 

You should also notice some new visual flair for them too!


[b]Rosary Beads, Sword Hearts and Ranged Attack![/b]

During our own pilgrimages through Cvstodia we noticed that some of the Sword Hearts and Rosary Beads weren’t applying their bonuses as intended. This has now been fixed!
We’ve also given the Penitent One’s ranged attack some attention, rebalancing it so that it now scales in damage and cost based on Mea Culpa’s level.


[b]Enemy Behaviour & Executions[/b]

Whilst going through your feedback we saw that some players, whilst enjoying the combat, felt that more could be done to make it feel smoother, more responsive and ‘fairer’.

In The Stir of Dawn we’ve revisited some enemies who will now feature better anticipation and recovery times. 

On top of this we’ve already updated the behaviour of some enemies to create a better combat experience that will feel smoother and reduce the occurrence of situations where the player feels they were beaten unfairly.

To further highlight the importance of the above point we have also adjusted the player hitbox to make combat fairer and reward skilful / risky plays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/1b1b4eac188a5b46767acc94be30246a223e338e.gif[/img]

We were really pleased to see how popular executions have been for everyone. We also saw how many of you wanted to see more instances of them, so we’ve added a new mechanic that will allow you to instigate an execution through skilled use of your abilities. 

On top of the existing system, Charged and Lunged attacks can now stun enemies in certain situations, such as a counter attack or striking a foe during the wind up of their attack.

Please note, this stun mechanic only works on enemies that can be executed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/b7aada360c821e7183aeeb26476389574d11b8d2.gif[/img]


[h1]Environmental Improvements[/h1]

Before we sign-off for the weekend and head towards Dawn, we also wanted to highlight that many areas of Cvstodia have received a visual update.

We don’t want to spoil these as we think you’ll greatly enjoy seeing as the world has evolved, with new furniture, decorations and background NPCs really bringing the world alive. 

We will leave a little peek for you below though…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/4d5fb9c64d8668ecf6bb11cf073b30037df577b9.gif[/img]

Penitent be the heart.

To start things off on your journey toward Dawn we will be focusing on the following for today’s post:
[list]
[*]New Game+ - ‘True Torment Mode’
[*]The Penitence System
[*]New Bosses - The Amanecidas
[*]New NPCs
[/list]
Whilst we shall be sharing useful information from our tomes of forbidden knowledge, we will be leaving some surprises and secrets for you to discover as you play through The Stir of Dawn yourself…

[previewyoutube=9QdGzJhunb4;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]New Game+ - True Torment Mode[/h1]

[b][u]SPOILER WARNING - GAMEPLAY & BOSS DETAILS[/u][/b]

New Game+ comes to Blasphemous in The Stir of Dawn, giving the penitent amongst us the opportunity to play through the whole game again with a greater challenge!

Enemies will:
[list]
[*]Deal more damage to you.
[*]Be able to take more damage from you.
[*]Feature better anticipation and recovery times (Also in NG).
[*]Improved behavior to create smoother combat and less ‘unfairness’ (Also in NG).
[/list]

But fear not! Whilst your foes have grown stronger, so have you! 

When starting a True Torment playthrough the Penitent One will start with the following upgrades from your previous playthrough:
[list]
[*]All Mea Culpa upgrades earned
[*]All Sword Hearts collected
[*]All Rosary Beads collected
[*]All Prayers unlocked
[/list]
Just as the Miracle gives, it takes away - The Penitent One will start NG+ with their base levels of Health, Fervour and Bile Flasks. In order to restore these precious resources to their former glory you will have to venture out and reclaim them once again!


[h1]The Penitence System[/h1]

Shortly after awakening in NG+ you will be offered a choice. The Miracle will bestow upon you the choice of the ‘Three Penitences’. 

Each penitence offers a set of handicaps and bonuses that lets you experience and play through blasphemous in a different way. These will offer a greater challenge that changes the rules of the game…

[b]Penitence of the Unwavering Faith[/b]

For those looking to have a more Prayer focused, caster style build.
[list]
[*]Melee attacks are half as effective.
[*]Fervour regenerates over time.
[*]Taking damage will reduce your fervour stocks.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/05c3d04a3041a470c2d153e2e573d018e54e230f.jpg[/img]


[b]Penitence of the Bleeding Heart[/b]

For those that relish combat and do not fear death.
[list]
[*]Your HP bar is replaced by Life Orbs.
[*]Taking damage will remove an orb.
[*]Bile Flasks will replenish multiple orbs over time.
[*]Taking damage during the healing process will halt it.
[*]Enemies will respawn every time you reenter a room.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/1fbf19dd6084c5ccbd18a4be9570258a4cdd8488.jpg[/img]


[b]Penitence of the True Guilt[/b]

For those that see failure as unacceptable.
[list]
[*]Upon death, all Tears of Atonement are placed on your Guilt Fragment.
[*]Falling in battle will maximise your Guilt Level.
[*]Bile Flasks do not heal you, but instead refill your Fervour.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/71839bc78953221dae24b9bb48850a4ccde3951c.jpg[/img]


[b]But then, penitence has its rewards…[/b]

Those that manage to embrace their chosen penance and prevail will be rewarded with a new skin as well as a powerful, unique Rosary Bead that both share the theme of said penance.

Each penance has its own set of rewards. Will you earn them all?


[h1]New Bosses & NPCs[/h1]

[b]The Amanecidas - New Game+ & The Stir of Dawn questline only[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/f104e5feed46f82f42055f7ff8ebd85ed10f0283.gif[/img]

The Amanecidas are ancient guardians of the Miracle, resting underground in their gilded sepulchers buried throughout Cvstodia.

They present the greatest challenges in the game and will push the Penitent One to their limit…

[list]
[*]Each Amanecidas wields a different weapon and moveset.
[*]New animated cutscenes are attached to them.
[*]Each feature a set of hand-crafted animations that rival that of the Penitent One.
[*]Get ready for new mechanics, moves and attacks never seen in the game before!
[*]Fight and defeat them all to face their master and engage in the most difficult boss fight in the game...
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/935073dda4daff2d193e2ef6bb0d7be3e0582aac.gif[/img]

Much like the three penitences, besting the Amanecidas and their master will earn the Penitent One powerful gifts. What they are, you will have to find out…


[b]New NPCs[/b]

From August 4th you will encounter new NPCs throughout Cvstodia. All of them will be available in NG+, however some will be absent in your NG (first) playthrough as they are directly linked to The Stir of Dawn DLC which is only available in NG+.

You may have spotted the new NPCs in the trailer or in our recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/774361/view/4173099803038881880]Spanish VO post[/url], but to keep the mystery and reward of discovery we’re only going into detail about two of them today.

[b]Jibrael[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/c2e97a4f281e4afa825d183948e52f1cbebdcedc.jpg[/img]

Jibrael is the condemned harbinger of the Amanecidas and a key NPC in The Stir of Dawn questline. You will meet Jibrael early on in your NG+ playthrough, if you find him, and by interacting with him you will begin the DLC questline. 

Keep an eye out for Jibrael as you progress through NG+ as only they and they alone can awake the Amanecidas from their slumber for you to challenge.


[b]Albero’s Newest Resident![/b]

The Penitent One’s pilgrimage is arduous and wrought with suffering and danger, but when The Stir of Dawn arrives so will some comfort in the form of a furry friend…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/50f45ea47c5cbf8bca0584d9f38fac482c01b16e.gif[/img]

This particular resident of Albero will appear for particularly lucky Penitent Ones, so if they do be sure to take a moment to give them a pet or two, or three, or twelve…


[h1]Friday 31st July - Next Post Details[/h1]

That wraps things up on our New Game+, Penitence System and Boss / NPC overview, but there’s more to come!

We’ll be creating another post on Friday that will detail:
[list]
[*]Community feedback and how we’ve put it into action.
[*]New map & expanded fast travel system.
[*]Enemy & Prayer rebalancing.
[*]Further gameplay and quality of life improvements.
[/list]
Penitent be the heart.

notes.title: Blasphemous - Patch 2 Live Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/295730d306440eb61169a410f58ffe44e0217422.jpg[/img]

I'm Maikel, from the design team at Blasphemous. I just wanted to take this chance to thank you all out there, on behalf of the whole team at The Game Kitchen. 

When we started this project, back in 2017, we couldn't imagine this getting so much attention. Not even close! The amount of love and support that Blasphemous has got after we released it 3 months ago it's astounding. We owe you a lot, and that's why we wanted to share some things with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/ec5e549b183a31bb37ef751920ea76e84fcfc227.jpg[/img]

Last week, Blasphemous got not one, but two awards at the Fun & Serious game festival! We were nominated alongside really awesome games, so it's an incredible honor to bring these awards home.

But more importantly, and as you might already imagine after reading the post title, we've been working really hard in some juicy tweaks and changes. The last patches were focused on fixing stuff that was broken and squashing bugs. But this one, the biggest update in Blasphemous so far, it's focused on YOUR feedback. 

We've been listening and reading your comments on the steam forums, reddit, twitter, your emails... You name it. We've had little time to reply to most of you (as there were a lot!), but we've been busy working! With this patch, we tried to make Blasphemous feel better and more accessible than ever, refining and polishing the experience as much as possible without actually changing the core game.

Without further ado, I'll leave you with the patch notes. Stay until the end!

The Game Kitchen.


[h1][b]Patch 2[/b][/h1]

[h1]Platforming improvements[/h1]
These improvements were made thanks to feedback from you, our players. Thank you to everyone who took the time to share their experiences on platforming in Blasphemous, we hope you enjoy these changes.
[list]
[*]Collision detection during jumps tweaked to improve jump feeling.
[*]Jumping in mid-air is now possible for a few frames after running off a platform (Coyote time / ghost jump).
[*]Grab cancel action added.
[*]The Penitent One is now be able to jump off walls, ledges and ladders by pressing the Grab cancel action.
[*]The Penitent One still can hold down to fall while hanging from a ledge, but the holding time has been adjusted.
[*]The Penitent One will only climb a ledge if the players press Up, to prevent accidental climbing.
[*]Damage while wall climbing now doesn't prevent further wall climbing. Before it was only available after touching the ground again.
[/list]

[h1]New controls screen[/h1]

The new controller screen was rebuilt from the ground up, including a much wider range of controller compatibility. Who’ll be the first person to achieve true penance using a steering wheel setup?  

On a more serious note we hope these widened options provide more accessibility for those with different controller wants and needs.
[list]
[*]Extended controller support. Even playing with a dance mat is possible!
[*]Mouse buttons and swipe gestures added.
[*]Improved control screen UI.
[*]Every action is now rebindable.
[*]Button tooltips are shown correctly after rebinding actions in every UI screen.
[/list]

[h1]Moving platforms rework[/h1]

Following some comments we’d seen here on the forums and social media, the team made some changes to reduce player downtime in areas that include moving platforms.

This should maintain a challenge for players, without the slow down in pace.
[list]
[*]Fixed a collision issue that made some players go through them on certain jumps.
[*]Added and reworked some annoying moving platforms to shorten wait times and improve level navigation.
[*]Iterated a few areas featuring moving platforms, to improve platforming and navigation, and make wait times shorter.
[/list]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added full Japanese language support.
[*]Fixed several typos in different languages.
[/list]

[h1]Player fixes and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused TPO to pass through walls in certain jump conditions.
[*]Removed ladder landing screen shake effect
[*]Fixed a bug that caused falling attacks to continually loop in rare situations.
[*]Improved Weight of Sin timing.
[/list]

[h1]Level changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved navigation in shortcut between Sleeping Canvases and Mercy Dreams (The infamous room full of spikes!)
[*]Slight geometry tweaks in Wasteland of the Buried Churches and Archcathedral Rooftops.
[/list]

[h1]Guilt Fragment placement fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]All spike traps have been corrected to prevent a strange behaviour forcing guilt fragments to appear in Albero.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Guilt Fragments to get stuck in between scenes under the elevator at Library of Negated Words sometimes.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Guilt Fragment appearing right in front of the burning tree on Perpetva's fight to be impossible to retrieve.
[/list]

[h1]Graphical fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage effects and other Vfx were not being shown on PC builds.
[*]Reflections were not working in scenes like the Halite Lake and the dark room after Melquiades.
[*]Fixed level sprites.
[*]Added decorative sprites of wax below red and blue candles on scenes.
[*]Socorro's animation loops fixed.
[*]When using a controller to exit the teleport menu, TPO didn't make an exit animation and remained invisible.
[*]Fix snow falling inside screen space (Mountains).
[*]Fixed door sprites clipping through the penitent one in Wasteland of Buried Churches.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Retribution animation
[*]In certain locations, the head of The Penitent One could be seen sticking out when falling down a pit.
[/list]

[h1]Softlock fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Great Elevator in Archcathedral Rooftops could cause a softlock
[*]Interacting with Our Lady of the Six Sorrows a second time could cause a softlock
[*]Dying when falling through a pit with the inventory open could cause a softlock
[/list]

[h1]Level fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mea Culpa level could be increased several times at the same shrine.
[*]The Penitent One could be hit while resting on a certain Prie Dieu.
[*]Fixed transitions to a few screens in which enemies will start attacking The Penitent One if the loading time took too long.
[*]Players could bypass abyss deathtraps when falling into them using the Weight of Sin skill.
[*]Removed an extra blue candle on Engracias' room that shouldn't be there.
[*]Fixed transitions where TPO would be facing the opposite direction they came from.
[*]Hanging chains of giant clapper in Jondo sometimes disappeared when they shouldn't
[*]Fixed Penitent One falling off the world when sliding through the door of the Bridge of the Three Calvaries.
[/list]

[h1]Storyline/NPC fixes[/h1]

[*]Duplicated Golden Thimble on gemino quest.

[*]Altasgracias' Egg could be lost on force quit.
[*]Escribar cutscene 3 doesn't show properly sometimes.

[h1]Item fixes[/h1]

[h1]Bosses fixes[/h1]

[*]Fixed Warden of the Silent Sorrow collider.
[*]The Penitent One will appear and perform the execution animation from both sides of Crisanta.
[/list]

[h1]Enemy fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Monfràgora errors fixed.
[*]Tizona flickering fixed.
[*]Amargura collider issues fixed. Improved hitbox.
[*]Guardainfante shockwave animation fix.
[*]Fixed Wraith enemy and projectile colliders.
[/list]

[h1]Misc fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed flasks refilling after defeating Ten Piedad and Charred Visage bosses due to an outdated saving state script.
[*]Mouse is now hidden by default.
[*]Map icon location fixes.
[/list]
[h1]Credits fixes[/h1]
[*]Backer credits updated and fixed.
[*]Credits updated.
[/list]

Just in case any console players are also here, this patch will be coming to all other platforms in the new year.


[h1][b]Giving you Penitent Ones out there many reasons to revisit Cvstodia in 2020![/b][/h1]

Your journey of penance is far from over...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/99de9fa86d9ca87fe9b2160af6919713dabd8316.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to share that the first free DLC for Blasphemous will be coming in early 2020…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/60cbf8f85780e23af05639aa714cd28c822fbb9c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content:
Hey Sinners,

As we work on upcoming patches and new content for Blasphemous we’ve been taking note of everyone’s feedback, seeing what you like and what you feel could do with some extra attention.

Recently the team took to Reddit to share our thoughts and what we’re looking to do in the near future, so we thought we’d share it with everyone here on Steam too! 

Please give a warm welcome to Enrique, Lead Level Designer on Blasphemous and bringer of platforming answers…


[b]Platforming, guilt and those spike pits[/b]

Hi, I'm the main level designer for Blasphemous and I want to take this opportunity to talk about some of the feedback we’ve been seeing around certain elements of the game.

[b]Guilt Fragments left in spike pits[/b]

I hate this bug as much as you do, guys, I really do! Luckily when we discovered it there were workarounds that could "patch" this issue under the current game terms - Killing bosses and using confessors would retrieve all lost guilt fragments, including the ones that were misplaced in spike pits or other hard to reach places.

Why and how does this happen? Well the reason is simple: Guilt Fragments record constantly safe positions on solid ground to remember where to spawn if the player dies. The problem was that, when dying on spikes, physics where still enabled, the Penitent One was still affected by gravity and sometimes it recorded the ground under the spikes as a safe position. This is what caused the issue. Thankfully for everyone here on Steam, this has already been patched with the console version on the way along with several other important fixes found after release thanks to you, the community.

[b]Platforming, ladders and nailing that jump[/b]

For patch 1.0.10 we're aiming for a big update on how platforming feels in Blasphemous. Not only will it improve how you land, but also how jumping works. When looking further into how these actions worked we found small but very important problems when performing these two actions. Navigating jumping puzzles and challenging areas should feel much smoother once this patch is live.

 We feel that these changes will have a big impact on the sense of unfairness that platforming could have in Blasphemous, making deaths feel deserved rather than cheap.

[b]Punishment - Straight to the point! [/b]

If you ask me, spikes are not the problem: the punishment for falling on them is, and especially when players don't feel that is their fault. 

In the case of spike deaths, instakills feels like a really mean punishment, even if the player can retrieve their guilt and keep their Tears of Atonement. We're still committed to keeping instakill as part of the experience, but we're considering a few ways to ease the player's frustration around this particular trap.

We’ve noticed that most of the reviews for Blasphemous include a mention of the spike traps and platforming in the list of negatives about our game. They are actually what lowered our review score in most cases. 

This is why we wanted to do something about it as soon as possible, we’re watching, we’re listening and we’re taking action!

So yeah, message received! We'll do our best to keep improving and building upon the foundations of Blasphemous.

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support.

notes.title: Patch 1 - Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey Sinners,

We just want to reiterate what we said yesterday and say a huge THANK YOU to everyone that has supported Blasphemous.

Since launch we've been collating your feedback on all aspects of the game, from bugs to gameplay. Even if we're not posting in all of your threads, rest assured we're keenly taking notes on what you're telling us.

You'll also notice that this is Patch 1, which means more patches and content updates will be on their way - launching Blasphemous doesn't mean we're finished! 

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/710f0c845168d783eac942041abf6b9aead65d51.gif[/img]

[h1]Major issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player save game could be corrupted on rare occasions.* 
[*]Player progress could be partially reset on rare occasions.*
[*]A backup system has been created.
[*]The player could be softlocked after killing Tres Angustias. 
[*]Fixed "Grievance Ascend" gate locked after respawning if the player died  while defeating Tres Angustias.

*Unfortunately, if your save was corrupted it won't be recoverable. To help protect our players should future bugs arise, the mentioned backup system has been created.
[/list]
[h1]UI issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Menu can’t be opened during interactions anymore
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]The player could accumulate large amounts of vertical speed by pausing in certain conditions. 
[*]There were screen shake and vibrations occurring after the player crouched at the bottom of a ladder.
[*]Crisanta could be damaged before the fight started using projectile attacks.[*]The player couldn’t attack upwards immediately after a dash. 
[*]The player could get stuck in the Wallclimb animation and could be exploited to levitate horizontally.
[/list]
[h1]Level geometry fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Penitent One getting stuck on the lower part of a wall-climb in Jondo (Right chain screen)
[*]Removed breakable wall leading to an infinite fall in Library of Negated Words.
[*]Fixed collisions in a room in Mercy Dreams where the Penitent One could get stuck into geometry after dashing and being hit with a projectile.
[*]Muddy floors in Holy Line and Desecrated Cistern had some collision issues and have been fixed. 
[*]Modified shortcut connecting Desecrated Cistern with Wasteland of the Buried Churches. Replaced blood platforms by normal platforms.
[/list]
[h1]Storyline fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The prayer Taranto to My Sister was missable. Now spawns if Esdras is dead and TPO doesn't own it.
[*]Gemino quest was missable and players could be locked out of the 100% completion. 
[*]Empty Golden Thimble spawns near Gémino if he converts to the tree form before talking to him.
[/list]
[h1]Balance tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blood Penitence cost has been increased and now scales with player Mea Culpa level. 
[/list]

That wraps up Patch 1! Thanks again for your patience whilst we worked on your feedback. Now the work continues on Patch 2 and our post-launch content!

Blessed be The Great Miracle!

notes.title: Blasphemous Launch - A thank you to the community!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s hard to choose where to start when there are so many emotions spinning around our heads and hearts, but there is only one thing that we at The Game Kitchen can say after these two incredible weeks since the September 10th release:

[h1][b]THANK YOU![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/295730d306440eb61169a410f58ffe44e0217422.jpg[/img]


And specially to our backers, who were the first ones believing in our vision. It’s thanks to them that now thousands of players across all platforms are unveiling the mysteries of Cvstodia. We are extremely humbled by the incredible reception that Blasphemous got.

 It still feels surreal to see some of our favourite journalists, content creators and streamers playing our game and giving us the thumbs up as well as hearing the stories and experiences from you, our players.

We’re having a great time watching how Blasphemous challenges all gamers out there, but we’re also pretty aware that our launch was not as perfect as it should have been. To address this the team are currently working hard on fixing and polishing all those problems that managed to escape months of intense QA. 

Believe us when we say that we listen to all your concerns and problems. Fixing these issues are our top priority right now (And our penitence! :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/7942d7522383176660f0707dd2af7869704ca43a.gif[/img]
[i]Time for the bugs to pay for their sins...[/i]

In that sense, we’re pleased to announce that there is an update coming very soon that should address the most critical issues reported by the community, including:
[list]
[*]Expected fix for player saves being corrupted on rare occasions.
[*]Expected fix for player progress partially resetting on rare occasions.
[*]Softlock fix after beating Tres Angustias.
[/list]
The full patch notes will be shared when the patch goes live in the near future, it’ll include gameplay, geometry, bug and quest progression fixes.


[h1]What’s next?[/h1]

We’re now focused on fixing the not so critical issues, which will follow shortly in our second patch.

More importantly it’s worth mentioning that we’ve started working on the first piece of Blasphemous post-launch content. This first update will focus on quality of life features and adjustments with our future content updates further expanding the world of Cvstodia and Blasphemous! 

By the blessing of the Great Miracle we hope to discuss this in more detail soon...
